packs.name: Model 1 · Rounded
packs.description: Rounded line-style settings icons drawn for Miyorare. Covers the main Settings screen and the inner settings screens; settings icons not covered by the pack keep the built-in artwork.

packs.name: Model 1 · Bold
packs.description: Bold line-style settings icons drawn for Miyorare: the Rounded shapes with a heavier stroke for maximum legibility.

packs.name: Model 1 · Slim
packs.description: Slim line-style settings icons drawn for Miyorare: the Rounded shapes with a light, airy stroke.

packs.name: Model 1 · Sharp
packs.description: Sharp line-style settings icons drawn for Miyorare: squared caps and corners for a crisp, geometric look.

packs.name: Model 1 · Filled
packs.description: Filled settings icons drawn for Miyorare: solid silhouettes with cut-out details.

packs.name: Model 2 · Angular
packs.description: Model 2 settings icons drawn for Miyorare: angular, geometric constructions with squared caps and corners — a different drawing model from Model 1, not just a restyle.

packs.name: Model 2 · Angular Filled
packs.description: Model 2 settings icons drawn for Miyorare, filled variant: solid angular silhouettes with cut-out details.

packs.name: Model 3 · Pixel
packs.description: Model 3 settings icons drawn for Miyorare: retro pixel-art glyphs on a 16x16 pixel grid — a different drawing model from Model 1 (rounded) and Model 2 (angular).

packs.name: Model 3 · Pixel Outline
packs.description: Model 3 settings icons drawn for Miyorare, pixel outline variant: only the edge pixels of the pixel-art glyphs, for a lighter hollow look.

packs.name: Model 4 · Kawaii
packs.description: Model 4 settings icons drawn for Miyorare: kawaii line glyphs with cat-ear, face and sparkle accents over the Model 1 constructions — a different drawing model from Model 1 (rounded), Model 2 (angular) and Model 3 (pixel).
